scenarios.name: ideal
scenarios.description: Ideal run: help, O2, IM adrenaline at 1:00 and 6:00, IV access, fluids.

events.text: Called for help — senior and crash team on the way.
I’m allergic to peanuts. They told me there weren’t any.
Airway: Talking in sentences. Voice slightly hoarse, lips swollen, no stridor.
Breathing: RR 22/min, SpO₂ 97% on air. Widespread expiratory wheeze.
Circulation: HR 114, BP 85/50. Capillary refill 3 seconds, warm and flushed.
Disability: GCS 15/15. Alert, very anxious. Pupils equal and reactive. Glucose 5.8 mmol/L.
Exposure: Raised itchy wheals across trunk and arms, flushed skin. Temperature 37.0 °C.
That’s easier… my throat’s opening up a bit.

scenarios.name: untreated
scenarios.description: No treatment: PEA arrest, then death after 15 minutes without ROSC.

events.text: I feel like I’m going to pass out…
Cardiac arrest. Pulseless electrical activity on the monitor.
Resuscitation stopped after 15 minutes. The patient has died.
